description: Check color contrast. Give fg and bg, or pairs (a list of {fg, bg, label, sizePx, bold}), or a palette. Returns the WCAG 2.2 ratio with AA and AAA results for the text size, APCA Lc with what it is enough for, the nearest passing color, and for palettes the color pairs that become indistinguishable under protanopia, deuteranopia or tritanopia. Accepts hex, rgb(), hsl() and CSS names.

bold.description: True if the text is bold, which changes the large-text threshold

palette.description: Colors to test against white, black and each other under color blindness

sizePx.description: Text size in CSS px, default 16

name: check_contrast
title: Contrast
